final: WITH district_counts AS (SELECT a.district_id, d.A3 AS region, COUNT(*) AS client_count FROM disp AS p JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = p.account_id JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id WHERE p.type = 'OWNER' GROUP BY a.district_id, d.A3), total AS (SELECT SUM(client_count) AS n FROM district_counts) SELECT dc.region, AVG(dc.client_count) AS avg_clients_per_district, AVG(dc.client_count * 1.0 / total.n) AS avg_district_share FROM district_counts AS dc CROSS JOIN total GROUP BY dc.region ORDER BY dc.region
